verdict.rationale: E2B ships extensive documented SDK/CLI APIs (Sandbox.create, files.read/write, commands.run, timeouts, metrics, snapshots, webhooks) with quickstart and reference docs, and explicit LLM/agent integration guides (connect-llms, coding-agents), demonstrating a fully documented public API surface for AI-native use. Missing for 10: no discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s across candidate paths) and no independent third-party audit of API completeness beyond vendor docs/community anecdotes.
